description: Rebuilds an AI-generated (or any) flat motion design video as clean, editable code: inline SVG shapes animated by one GSAP timeline, seekable frame by frame, looping seamlessly, checked side by side against the source; and optionally turns an interface recording into a real interactive website (GSAP ScrollTrigger, real clicks). Ships scripts to study the video (frames, cuts, contact sheet, exact palette), render the code to mp4/GIF through anim.seek, compare it with the source frame by frame and check the loop seam and page contract. Use when the user wants a video, GIF, Lottie-like clip, motion design shot, animated logo, UI screen recording or AI video "recreated in code", "converted to SVG/GSAP", "made into an HTML animation" or "made into a real site". Not for photographic footage, 3D rendering or video editing.
